tests.reason: Crediting VTNA is a write; staging writes to the production Supabase project, so it is never exercised by a staging probe. The ledger is proven by applying the migration twice to a local Postgres replica of the live wallet tables (scripts/ci/test-vtid-04809-vtna-ledger.sh, run inside the first suite) and by the caller suites. The migration itself is applied separately via RUN-MIGRATION.yml after approval.
